QNX 8.0 procnto implements /proc with a different layout (/proc/<pid>/ entries such as as, cmdline, ctl, exefile; /proc/self/ is the caller's address space). Linux files under /proc do not map 1:1; QNX docs say not to use /proc in production to control or monitor processes. Review this path manually.
